report.explanation: All current telemetry for the order service is healthy: checkout trace OK at 64ms, error rate 0.0012, p95 70ms, zero dependency timeouts and zero db pool waiters, INFO 200 logs. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause (http-500, db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, downstream-latency, memory-leak, bad-configuration). The alert is not corroborated, so no bounded root cause can be established; hand off for operator review.
